name: PipericBot
description: The crawler behind Piperic, a B2B website-intelligence service that profiles public sites by technology, category and language. The operator describes it as comparable to BuiltWith or Wappalyzer: it fetches publicly accessible home pages plus standard public files such as robots.txt, llms.txt, ai.txt and humans.txt, typically a single home-page request per domain at a low rate. It states it bypasses no login or paywall, reaches no private or restricted area, and submits no forms, and it publishes a removal page for site owners who want their domain out of the index.
